podcast.body: Her very first album, released in 2006, immediately established Taylor Swift as a singer-songwriter who was "shading the boys who'd humiliated her" through her lyrics. This debut laid the foundation for her career built on personal narratives and diss tracks. "From her very first album, the self-titled Taylor Swift in 2006, the budding singer-songwriter was shading the boys who'd humiliated her."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
